g.text: Cloud Center of Excellence Charter Document

text.tspan: Explain why the CCOE is being created and the problem(s) it's expected to solve
Summarize the business benefits to be realized through the CCOE
Summarize the functions organizational leaders and sponsors are requiring the CCOE to perform
Document the frequency and process by which the Charter document will be reviewed, by whom, when and how it will be updated
Document each board member's role who will be accountable for the direction and overall success of the CCOE
